title: heliomeris multiflora var. brevifolia
intro: Heliomeris multiflora var. brevifolia, commonly known as Rocky Mountain heliomeris or Mountain heliomeris, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Heliomeris multiflora var. brevifolia include antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for wound care and skin issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
